selected_evidence.requirement: Run the worker as managed service inventory-worker
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the SysV service definition, enabled boot links, successful status/restart, and the exact worker command line.
Shows creation of the dedicated non-login system account and the live worker running with inventorysvc UID 105 and GID 112.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, node1 reports Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.

Baseline boot ID was 10de8ec5-9cce-4c68-b857-73fdab226881; the reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is ecbc0cc4-1d63-48ef-8f2d-a6549559ea09; post-reboot proof shows inventory-worker running as inventorysvc with unchanged worker checksum and persistent boot registration.

commands.command:
cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-worker <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          inventory-worker
# Required-Start:    $remote_fs $syslog
# Required-Stop:     $remote_fs $syslog
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Inventory comparison worker
### END INIT INFO

PATH=/sbin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/usr/bin
DAEMON=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
NAME=inventory-worker
USER=inventorysvc
PIDFILE=/var/run/$NAME.pid

case "$1" in
  start)
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
      PID=`cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null`
      if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
      fi
      rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    fi
    start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --background --make-pidfile \
      --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --chuid "$USER" --exec "$DAEMON"
    sleep 1
    PID=`cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null`
    [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null
    ;;
  stop)
    start-stop-daemon --stop --quiet --oknodo --retry TERM/10/KILL/5 \
      --pidfile "$PIDFILE"
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    ;;
  restart|force-reload)
    "$0" stop
    "$0" start
    ;;
  status)
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
      PID=`cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null`
      if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '%s is running (pid %s)\n' "$NAME" "$PID"
        exit 0
      fi
    fi
    printf '%s is not running\n' "$NAME"
    exit 3
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'Usage: %s {start|stop|restart|force-reload|status}\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
exit 0
ANTRIEB_EOF
